sloka: एवमुक्तः सुरैर्ब्रह्मा ऽचिन्तयत् पद्मसम्भवः ।चिन्तिता चोपतस्थे ऽस्य पार्श्वं देवी सरस्वती ।। ७.१०.४१ ॥
transliteration: evamuktaḥ surairbrahmā 'cintayat padmasambhavaḥ ।cintitā copatasthe 'sya pārśvaṁ devī sarasvatī ।। 7.10.41 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the gods, Brahma, born from a lotus, pondered, and as he thought, the goddess Saraswati approached his side.
